caption_facts: The campaign asked people to create a 15-second reel using Winn Foods' official Souper Tasty track, titled Hello I am MIMU.
The campaign language and indexed post terms identify Mimu as a mascot.
observations.visual_observation: The official campaign artwork depicts Mimu as a black-and-white panda wearing a gold chain and a large MIMU pendant against a red stage backdrop.
observations.historical_promotion_note: The post described a contest that ran from 16-19 December 2025. The draft does not present this expired promotion as active.

caption_facts: Winn Foods announced that it had arrived at six D-Mart stores in Chhattisgarh.
The post says Mimu was excited to celebrate the arrival.
observations.visual_observation: The accessible image description identifies a panda/bear character, luggage, and the text WINN IS HERE.

caption_facts: The post asks which Winn soup the reader would try first.
The creative places Mimu alongside the Winn soup range.
observations.visual_observation: The accessible image description shows multiple Winn soup packs and the name MIMU.

limitations: No first-party source reviewed here provides an approved origin story, age, place of origin, speaking style, or detailed personality biography for Mimu.
The draft therefore avoids inventing a backstory or attributing dialogue to the mascot.
